name: t1_design
prompt:
A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat-vector diagram for a Chinese academic report. The composition MUST be landscape, clearly wider than tall, roughly 2:1. Keep every band short and stretched across the full width. IMPORTANT: do NOT draw any title, heading, or caption anywhere. Pure white background. Palette: deep navy #1B3A6B, crimson #C42B1C, gold #C9A227, light gray #E8EAED. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible. No shadows, no gradients.

Four SHORT FULL-WIDTH horizontal bands stacked vertically with small gaps, from TOP to BOTTOM:

Band 1 (light gray bar, one line of dark Chinese text): 服务成果　研究报告 · 咨政报告 · 著作 · 学术论文

Band 2 (three crimson rounded boxes side by side, each about one third of the width): each box has a white bold Chinese title line and a smaller white Chinese sub-line:
Box 1 title 溯源检索, sub-line 收材料 带出处
Box 2 title 学术助研, sub-line 打标签 归位 找发现
Box 3 title 教材评价与合规审查, sub-line 六维评价 风险提示

Band 3 (narrow gold bar, one line of dark Chinese text): 一条规范　每条材料必须带出处

Band 4 (one wide navy rounded box): a white bold Chinese label 材料库 on the LEFT, and to its right three white rounded chips in a row with dark Chinese text: 政策文本 / 文献史料 / 教材案例

Draw short thin vertical gold arrows pointing upward between the bands.

name: t2_compliance
prompt:
A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat-vector process diagram for a Chinese academic report. The composition MUST be landscape, clearly wider than tall, roughly 2:1. IMPORTANT: do NOT draw any title, heading, or caption anywhere. Pure white background. Palette: deep navy #1B3A6B, crimson #C42B1C, gold #C9A227, green #2E7D32, gray #8A8F98. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible. No shadows, no gradients.

A left-to-right chain of four rounded boxes connected by thick gold right-pointing arrows, occupying the upper two thirds of the canvas. Each box has a bold title line and a smaller sub-line:
Box 1 (navy, white text) title 待审教材文本, sub-line 章节 案例 表述
Box 2 (gold, dark text) title 助手比对, sub-line 对照政策库规范表述
Box 3 (gold, dark text) title 生成提示清单, sub-line 标出存疑表述并附出处
Box 4 (crimson, white text) title 专家判定, sub-line 委员会作出结论

BELOW the chain, one wide gray rounded bar spanning the full width with dark Chinese text on ONE line: 助手只作比对与提示，不作定性结论

name: t3_team
prompt:
A WIDE LANDSCAPE flat-vector process-and-incentive diagram for a Chinese academic report. The composition MUST be landscape, clearly wider than tall, roughly 2:1. IMPORTANT: do NOT draw any title, heading, or caption anywhere. Pure white background. Palette: deep navy #1B3A6B, gold #C9A227, light gray #E8EAED. Bold crisp Chinese sans-serif typography, perfectly legible. No shadows, no gradients.

UPPER HALF: a left-to-right chain of four navy rounded boxes connected by thick gold right-pointing arrows. Each box has a white bold Chinese title line and a smaller light-gray Chinese sub-line:
Box 1 title 三院招募, sub-line 马院 教育 文法
Box 2 title 岗前培训, sub-line 规范手册 培训考核
Box 3 title 三级作业, sub-line 本科生初标 研究生复核 教师指导确认
Box 4 title 合格验收, sub-line 抽检与一致性检验

LOWER HALF: a horizontal row of four gold rounded boxes, each with dark bold Chinese text on two lines, under a thin gray label bar reading 激励:
Box A line1 按合格件计酬, line2 多劳多得
Box B line1 学时与学分, line2 实践证明
Box C line1 汇编署名, line2 成果致谢
Box D line1 优秀评选, line2 老带新上浮

Draw a thick gold curved arrow leaving Box 4 on the right, sweeping down and back to the LEFT edge, returning into Box 1, showing a repeating cycle.
